name: pdf-rag
description: Upload a PDF, ask questions about it, get answers with page citations.

scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm --dir server install && pnpm --dir client install
scripts.dev: pnpm run infra && concurrently --names "server,worker,client" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,green" --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm --dir server run dev" "pnpm --dir server run dev:worker" "pnpm --dir client run dev"
